payload.explanation: Diagnostic report identifies session_c813da25ab61 as the root blocker: it ran the same inventory UPDATE and is idle in transaction holding an uncommitted row lock, blocking the business request session_9c794be1dd06. The state report confirms session_c813da25ab61 is eligible for rollback_session, while the business request itself is not modifiable. Rolling back the blocker releases the lock and lets the pending decrement complete; other idle sessions are not in the blocking chain and are preserved.
